caption: The drawing depicts an object shown from three angles: a top view, a side view, and an angled perspective view. The container has a lid with a hinge line visible, and a handle extends upward and curves over the top, attached to the container with a chain. The color scheme uses shades of grey and black, with the drawing rendered on a beige or light brown background. The detail emphasizes the structure and form of the object, with lines and shading indicating depth and curvature.
